typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BatchId as integer ()
}

source(output(
		Group as string,
		Subscriber as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> ReadFalloutMembers
ReadFalloutMembers derive({Copy of Group} = Group,
		{Copy of Subscriber} = Subscriber) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(BatchId = $BatchId) ~> BatchId
BatchId sink(input(
		SubscriberID as string,
		BatchID as integer,
		GroupID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		SubscriberID = {Copy of Subscriber},
		BatchID = BatchId,
		GroupID = {Copy of Group})) ~> OLEDBDestination
